outcome: Resolution of placental mass (reduction in size on MRI)
Reduction in beta-Human Chorionic Gonadotropin (hCG) levels
cohort: A 35-year-old primigravida presenting at term with placenta percreta and bladder invasion.
finding: Placenta percreta with bladder invasion can present with delayed gross haematuria two months post-delivery and respond to methotrexate chemotherapy, leading to a significant reduction in mass size and hCG levels.
followup_time: At least 2 months post-delivery, until the patient declined further follow-up after chemotherapy.
